verses.original: Τότε οὖν ἔλαβεν ὁ Πιλᾶτος τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐμαστίγωσεν
verses.transliteration: Tote oun elaben ho Pilatos ton Iēsoun kai emastigōsen
verses.literal: Then - Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged
verses.literalPt: PILATOS, pois, tomou então a Jesus, e o açoitou.

verses.original: καὶ οἱ στρατιῶται πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν αὐτοῦ τῇ κεφαλῇ καὶ ἱμάτιον πορφυροῦν περιέβαλον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai hoi stratiōtai plexantes stephanon ex akanthōn epethēkan autou tē kephalē kai himation porphyroun periebalon auton
verses.literal: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns set it on His head and dressed Him in a purple robe
verses.literalPt: E os soldados, tecendo uma coroa de espinhos, lha puseram sobre a cabeça, e lhe vestiram roupa de púrpura.

verses.original: καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον Χαῖρε ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἐδίδοσαν αὐτῷ ῥαπίσματα
verses.transliteration: kai ērchonto pros auton kai elegon Chaire ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn kai edidosan autō rhapismata
verses.literal: And they went up to Him again and again saying Hail King of the Jews and slapping Him in the face . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E diziam: Salve, Rei dos Judeus. E davam-lhe bofetadas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πάλιν ἔξω ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἴδε ἄγω ὑμῖν αὐτὸν ἔξω ἵνα γνῶτε ὅτι οὐδεμίαν αἰτίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai exēlthen palin exō ho Pilatos kai legei autois Ide agō hymin auton exō hina gnōte hoti oudemian aitian heuriskō en autō
verses.literal: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews Look I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him
verses.literalPt: Então Pilatos saiu outra vez fora, e disse-lhes: Eis aqui vo-lo trago fora, para que saibais que não acho nele crime algum.

verses.original: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔξω φορῶν τὸν ἀκάνθινον στέφανον καὶ τὸ πορφυροῦν ἱμάτιον καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἰδοὺ ὁ ἄνθρωπος
verses.transliteration: exēlthen oun ho Iēsous exō phorōn ton akanthinon stephanon kai to porphyroun himation kai legei autois Idou ho anthrōpos
verses.literal: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe Pilate said to them Here is the man
verses.literalPt: Saiu, pois, Jesus fora, levando a coroa de espinhos e roupa de púrpura. E disse-lhes Pilatos: Eis aqui o homem.

verses.original: Ὅτε οὖν εἶδον αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ἐκραύγασαν λέγοντες Σταύρωσον σταύρωσον Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος Λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς καὶ σταυρώσατε ἐγὼ γὰρ οὐχ εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν
verses.transliteration: Hote oun eidon auton hoi archiereis kai hoi hypēretai ekraugasan legontes Staurōson staurōson Legei autois ho Pilatos Labete auton hymeis kai staurōsate egō gar ouch heuriskō en autō aitian
verses.literal: As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him they shouted . . . Crucify Him Crucify Him You take Him and crucify Him - Pilate replied . . . for I find no basis for a charge against Him
verses.literalPt: Vendo-o, pois, os principais dos sacerdotes e os servos, clamaram, dizendo: Crucifica-o, crucifica-o. Disse-lhes Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e crucificai-o; porque eu nenhum crime acho nele.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Ἡμεῖς νόμον ἔχομεν καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὀφείλει ἀποθανεῖν ὅτι Υἱὸν Θεοῦ ἑαυτὸν ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan autō hoi Ioudaioi Hēmeis nomon echomen kai kata ton nomon opheilei apothanein hoti Huion Theou heauton epoiēsen
verses.literal: We have a law answered the Jews and according to that law He must die because He declared Himself to be the Son of God
verses.literalPt: Responderam-lhe os judeus: Nós temos uma lei e, segundo a nossa lei, deve morrer, porque se fez Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἤκουσεν ὁ Πιλᾶτος τοῦτον τὸν λόγον μᾶλλον ἐφοβήθη
verses.transliteration: Hote oun ēkousen ho Pilatos touton ton logon mallon ephobēthē
verses.literal: When Pilate heard this statement he was even more afraid
verses.literalPt: E Pilatos, quando ouviu esta palavra, mais atemorizado ficou.

verses.original: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον πάλιν καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Πόθεν εἶ σύ Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀπόκρισιν οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai eisēlthen eis to praitōrion palin kai legei tō Iēsou Pothen ei sy Ho de Iēsous apokrisin ouk edōken autō
verses.literal: and he went back into the Praetorium Where are You from he asked - But Jesus gave no . . . answer
verses.literalPt: E entrou outra vez na audiência, e disse a Jesus: De onde és tu? Mas Jesus não lhe deu resposta.

verses.original: Λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος Ἐμοὶ οὐ λαλεῖς οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχω ἀπολῦσαί σε καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω σταυρῶσαί σε
verses.transliteration: Legei oun autō ho Pilatos Emoi ou laleis ouk oidas hoti exousian echō apolysai se kai exousian echō staurōsai se
verses.literal: So Pilate said to Him Do You refuse to speak to me Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe, pois, Pilatos: Não me falas a mim? Não sabes tu que tenho poder para te crucificar e tenho poder para te soltar?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Οὐκ εἶχες ἐξουσίαν κατ’ ἐμοῦ οὐδεμίαν εἰ μὴ ἦν δεδομένον σοι ἄνωθεν διὰ τοῦτο ὁ παραδούς μέ σοι μείζονα ἁμαρτίαν ἔχει
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autō Iēsous Ouk eiches exousian kat’ emou oudemian ei mē ēn dedomenon soi anōthen dia touto ho paradous me soi meizona hamartian echei
verses.literal: Jesus answered You would have no authority over . . . Me if it were not given to you from above Therefore the one who handed Me over . . . to you is guilty of greater sin
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Nenhum poder terias contra mim, se de cima não te fosse dado; mas aquele que me entregou a ti maior pecado tem.

verses.original: Ἐκ τούτου ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐζήτει ἀπολῦσαι αὐτόν οἱ δὲ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐκραύγασαν λέγοντες Ἐὰν τοῦτον ἀπολύσῃς οὐκ εἶ φίλος τοῦ Καίσαρος πᾶς ὁ βασιλέα ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν ἀντιλέγει τῷ Καίσαρι
verses.transliteration: Ek toutou ho Pilatos ezētei apolysai auton hoi de Ioudaioi ekraugasan legontes Ean touton apolysēs ouk ei philos tou Kaisaros pas ho basilea heauton poiōn antilegei tō Kaisari
verses.literal: From then on . . . Pilate tried to release Him but the Jews kept shouting . . . If you release this man you are no friend of Caesar Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar
verses.literalPt: Desde então Pilatos procurava soltá-lo; mas os judeus clamavam, dizendo: Se soltas este, não és amigo de César; qualquer que se faz rei é contra César.

verses.original: Ὁ οὖν Πιλᾶτος ἀκούσας τῶν λόγων τούτων ἤγαγεν ἔξω τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ βήματος εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον Λιθόστρωτον Ἑβραϊστὶ δὲ Γαββαθα
verses.transliteration: Ho oun Pilatos akousas tōn logōn toutōn ēgagen exō ton Iēsoun kai ekathisen epi bēmatos eis topon legomenon Lithostrōton Hebraisti de Gabbatha
verses.literal: When Pilate heard these words he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement which in Hebrew is Gabbatha
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, Pilatos este dito, levou Jesus para fora, e assentou-se no tribunal, no lugar chamado Litóstrotos, e em hebraico Gabatá.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ Παρασκευὴ τοῦ πάσχα ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη καὶ λέγει τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις Ἴδε ὁ Βασιλεὺς ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ēn de Paraskeuē tou pascha hōra ēn hōs hektē kai legei tois Ioudaiois Ide ho Basileus hymōn
verses.literal: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover about the sixth hour And Pilate said to the Jews Here is your King
verses.literalPt: E era a preparação da páscoa, e quase à hora sexta; e disse aos judeus: Eis aqui o vosso Rei.

verses.original: Ἐκραύγασαν οὖν Ἐκεῖνοι Ἆρον ἆρον σταύρωσον αὐτόν Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος Τὸν Βασιλέα ὑμῶν σταυρώσω Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς Οὐκ ἔχομεν βασιλέα εἰ μὴ Καίσαρα
verses.transliteration: Ekraugasan oun Ekeinoi Aron aron staurōson auton Legei autois ho Pilatos Ton Basilea hymōn staurōsō Apekrithēsan hoi archiereis Ouk echomen basilea ei mē Kaisara
verses.literal: At this they shouted Away with Him Away with Him Crucify Him Shall I crucify your King Pilate asked . . . We have no king but . . . Caesar replied the chief priests
verses.literalPt: Mas eles bradaram: Tira, tira, crucifica-o. Disse-lhes Pilatos: Hei de crucificar o vosso Rei? Responderam os principais dos sacerdotes: Não temos rei, senão César.

verses.original: Τότε οὖν παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν αὐτοῖς ἵνα σταυρωθῇ Παρέλαβον οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Tote oun paredōken auton autois hina staurōthē Parelabon oun ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Then . . . Pilate handed Jesus over . . . to be crucified and the soldiers took Him away
verses.literalPt: Então, conseqüentemente entregou-lho, para que fosse crucificado. E tomaram a Jesus, e o levaram.

verses.original: Καὶ βαστάζων ἑαυτῷ τὸν σταυρὸν ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τὸν λεγόμενον Κρανίου τόπον ὃ λέγεται Ἑβραϊστὶ Γολγοθᾶ
verses.transliteration: Kai bastazōn heautō ton stauron exēlthen eis ton legomenon Kraniou topon ho legetai Hebraisti Golgotha
verses.literal: Carrying His own cross He went out to The Place of the Skull which in Hebrew is called Golgotha
verses.literalPt: E, levando ele às costas a sua cruz, saiu para o lugar chamado Caveira, que em hebraico se chama Gólgota,

verses.original: ὅπου αὐτὸν ἐσταύρωσαν καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ἄλλους δύο ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐντεῦθεν μέσον δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: hopou auton estaurōsan kai met’ autou allous dyo enteuthen kai enteuthen meson de ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: There they crucified Him and with Him two others one on each side . . . . . . with Jesus in the middle
verses.literalPt: Onde o crucificaram, e com ele outros dois, um de cada lado, e Jesus no meio.

verses.original: Ἔγραψεν δὲ καὶ τίτλον ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ ἔθηκεν ἐπὶ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἦν δὲ γεγραμμένον ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Ο ΝΑΖΩΡΑΙΟΣ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ
verses.transliteration: Egrapsen de kai titlon ho Pilatos kai ethēken epi tou staurou ēn de gegrammenon IĒSOUS HO NAZŌRAIOS HO BASILEUS TŌN IOUDAIŌN
verses.literal: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross It read . . . JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS
verses.literalPt: E Pilatos escreveu também um título, e pô-lo em cima da cruz; e nele estava escrito: JESUS NAZARENO, O REI DOS JUDEUS.

verses.original: Τοῦτον οὖν τὸν τίτλον πολλοὶ ἀνέγνωσαν τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἦν ὁ τόπος τῆς πόλεως ὅπου ἐσταυρώθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἦν γεγραμμένον Ἑβραϊστί Ῥωμαϊστί Ἑλληνιστί
verses.transliteration: Touton oun ton titlon polloi anegnōsan tōn Ioudaiōn hoti engys ēn ho topos tēs poleōs hopou estaurōthē ho Iēsous kai ēn gegrammenon Hebraisti Rhōmaisti Hellēnisti
verses.literal: Many of the Jews read this sign because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city and it was written in Hebrew Latin and Greek
verses.literalPt: E muitos dos judeus leram este título; porque o lugar onde Jesus estava crucificado era próximo da cidade; e estava escrito em hebraico, grego e latim.

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν τῷ Πιλάτῳ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Μὴ γράφε Ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἐκεῖνος εἶπεν Βασιλεύς εἰμι τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: elegon oun tō Pilatō hoi archiereis tōn Ioudaiōn Mē graphe Ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn all’ hoti ekeinos eipen Basileus eimi tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate Do not write The King of the Jews but only that He said I am the King of the Jews
verses.literalPt: Diziam, pois, os principais sacerdotes dos judeus a Pilatos: Não escrevas, O Rei dos Judeus, mas que ele disse: Sou o Rei dos Judeus.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πιλᾶτος Ὃ γέγραφα γέγραφα
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē ho Pilatos Ho gegrapha gegrapha
verses.literal: Pilate answered What I have written I have written
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Pilatos: O que escrevi, escrevi.

verses.original: Οἱ οὖν στρατιῶται ὅτε ἐσταύρωσαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἔλαβον τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησαν τέσσαρα μέρη ἑκάστῳ στρατιώτῃ μέρος καὶ τὸν χιτῶνα ἦν δὲ ὁ χιτὼν ἄραφος ἐκ τῶν ἄνωθεν ὑφαντὸς δι’ ὅλου
verses.transliteration: Hoi oun stratiōtai hote estaurōsan ton Iēsoun elabon ta himatia autou kai epoiēsan tessara merē hekastō stratiōtē meros kai ton chitōna ēn de ho chitōn araphos ek tōn anōthen hyphantos di’ holou
verses.literal: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus they divided . . . . . . His garments into four parts one for each soldier with the tunic remaining - It was seamless woven in one piece . . . from top to bottom
verses.literalPt: Tendo, pois, os soldados crucificado a Jesus, tomaram as suas vestes, e fizeram quatro partes, para cada soldado uma parte; e também a túnica. A túnica, porém, tecida toda de alto a baixo, não tinha costura.

verses.original: εἶπαν οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Μὴ σχίσωμεν αὐτόν ἀλλὰ λάχωμεν περὶ αὐτοῦ τίνος ἔσται ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ ἡ λέγουσα Διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτιά μου ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἱματισμόν μου ἔβαλον κλῆρον Οἱ μὲν οὖν στρατιῶται ταῦτα ἐποίησαν
verses.transliteration: eipan oun pros allēlous Mē schisōmen auton alla lachōmen peri autou tinos estai hina hē graphē plērōthē hē legousa Diemerisanto ta himatia mou heautois kai epi ton himatismon mou ebalon klēron Hoi men oun stratiōtai tauta epoiēsan
verses.literal: So they said to one another Let us not tear it . . . Instead let us cast lots to see who will get it This was to fulfill the Scripture . . . . . . They divided My garments among them and cast lots for My clothing So that is what the soldiers did
verses.literalPt: Disseram, pois, uns aos outros: Não a rasguemos, mas lancemos sortes sobre ela, para ver de quem será. Para que se cumprisse a Escritura que diz: Repartiram entre si as minhas vestes, E sobre a minha vestidura lançaram sortes. Os soldados, pois, fizeram estas coisas.

verses.original: Εἱστήκεισαν δὲ παρὰ τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀδελφὴ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Κλωπᾶ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνή
verses.transliteration: Heistēkeisan de para tō staurō tou Iēsou hē mētēr autou kai hē adelphē tēs mētros autou Maria hē tou Klōpa kai Maria hē Magdalēnē
verses.literal: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene
verses.literalPt: E junto à cruz de Jesus estava sua mãe, e a irmã de sua mãe, Maria mulher de Clopas, e Maria Madalena.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς οὖν ἰδὼν τὴν μητέρα καὶ τὸν μαθητὴν παρεστῶτα ὃν ἠγάπα λέγει τῇ μητρί Γύναι ἴδε ὁ υἱός σου
verses.transliteration: Iēsous oun idōn tēn mētera kai ton mathētēn parestōta hon ēgapa legei tē mētri Gynai ide ho huios sou
verses.literal: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby He said to His mother Woman here is your son
verses.literalPt: Ora Jesus, vendo ali sua mãe, e que o discípulo a quem ele amava estava presente, disse a sua mãe: Mulher, eis aí o teu filho.

verses.original: εἶτα λέγει τῷ μαθητῇ Ἴδε ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ ἀπ’ ἐκείνης τῆς ὥρας ἔλαβεν ὁ μαθητὴς αὐτὴν εἰς τὰ ἴδια
verses.transliteration: eita legei tō mathētē Ide hē mētēr sou kai ap’ ekeinēs tēs hōras elaben ho mathētēs autēn eis ta idia
verses.literal: Then He said to the disciple Here is your mother So from that hour this disciple took her into his home
verses.literalPt: Depois disse ao discípulo: Eis aí tua mãe. E desde aquela hora o discípulo a recebeu em sua casa.

verses.original: Μετὰ τοῦτο εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤδη πάντα τετέλεσται ἵνα τελειωθῇ ἡ γραφὴ λέγει Διψῶ
verses.transliteration: Meta touto eidōs ho Iēsous hoti ēdē panta tetelestai hina teleiōthē hē graphē legei Dipsō
verses.literal: After this knowing that everything had now been accomplished and to fulfill the Scripture Jesus said I am thirsty
verses.literalPt: Depois, sabendo Jesus que já todas as coisas estavam terminadas, para que a Escritura se cumprisse, disse: Tenho sede.

verses.original: σκεῦος ἔκειτο ὄξους μεστόν σπόγγον οὖν μεστὸν τοῦ ὄξους ὑσσώπῳ περιθέντες προσήνεγκαν αὐτοῦ τῷ στόματι
verses.transliteration: skeuos ekeito oxous meston spongon oun meston tou oxous hyssōpō perithentes prosēnenkan autou tō stomati
verses.literal: A jar of sour wine was sitting there So they soaked a sponge in the wine put it on a stalk of hyssop and lifted it to His mouth
verses.literalPt: Estava, pois, ali um vaso cheio de vinagre. E encheram de vinagre uma esponja, e, pondo-a num hissope, lha chegaram à boca.

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν ἔλαβεν τὸ ὄξος ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τετέλεσται καὶ κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκεν τὸ πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: hote oun elaben to oxos ho Iēsous eipen Tetelestai kai klinas tēn kephalēn paredōken to pneuma
verses.literal: When Jesus had received the sour wine He said It is finished And bowing His head He yielded up His spirit
verses.literalPt: E, quando Jesus tomou o vinagre, disse: Está consumado. E, inclinando a cabeça, entregou o espírito.

verses.original: Οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι ἐπεὶ Παρασκευὴ ἦν ἵνα μὴ μείνῃ ἐπὶ τοῦ σταυροῦ τὰ σώματα ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ ἦν γὰρ μεγάλη ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνου τοῦ σαββάτου ἠρώτησαν τὸν Πιλᾶτον ἵνα κατεαγῶσιν αὐτῶν τὰ σκέλη καὶ ἀρθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi oun Ioudaioi epei Paraskeuē ēn hina mē meinē epi tou staurou ta sōmata en tō sabbatō ēn gar megalē hē hēmera ekeinou tou sabbatou ērōtēsan ton Pilaton hina kateagōsin autōn ta skelē kai arthōsin
verses.literal: It was the day of Preparation and the next day was a High Sabbath In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed
verses.literalPt: Os judeus, pois, para que no sábado não ficassem os corpos na cruz, visto como era a preparação (pois era grande o dia de sábado), rogaram a Pilatos que se lhes quebrassem as pernas, e fossem tirados.

verses.original: ἦλθον οὖν οἱ στρατιῶται καὶ τοῦ μὲν πρώτου κατέαξαν τὰ σκέλη καὶ τοῦ ἄλλου τοῦ συσταυρωθέντος αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ēlthon oun hoi stratiōtai kai tou men prōtou kateaxan ta skelē kai tou allou tou systaurōthentos autō
verses.literal: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus and those of the other
verses.literalPt: Foram, pois, os soldados, e, na verdade, quebraram as pernas ao primeiro, e ao outro que como ele fora crucificado;

verses.original: ἐπὶ δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐλθόντες ὡς εἶδον ἤδη αὐτὸν τεθνηκότα οὐ κατέαξαν αὐτοῦ τὰ σκέλη
verses.transliteration: epi de ton Iēsoun elthontes hōs eidon ēdē auton tethnēkota ou kateaxan autou ta skelē
verses.literal: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead they did not break His legs
verses.literalPt: Mas, vindo a Jesus, e vendo-o já morto, não lhe quebraram as pernas.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ εἷς τῶν στρατιωτῶν λόγχῃ αὐτοῦ τὴν πλευρὰν ἔνυξεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εὐθὺς αἷμα καὶ ὕδωρ
verses.transliteration: all’ heis tōn stratiōtōn lonchē autou tēn pleuran enyxen kai exēlthen euthys haima kai hydōr
verses.literal: Instead one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear and immediately blood and water flowed out
verses.literalPt: Contudo um dos soldados lhe furou o lado com uma lança, e logo saiu sangue e água.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ἑωρακὼς μεμαρτύρηκεν καὶ ἀληθινὴ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία καὶ ἐκεῖνος οἶδεν ὅτι ἀληθῆ λέγει ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς πιστεύητε
verses.transliteration: kai ho heōrakōs memartyrēken kai alēthinē autou estin hē martyria kai ekeinos oiden hoti alēthē legei hina kai hymeis pisteuēte
verses.literal: The one who saw it has testified to this and his testimony is true He knows that he is telling the truth so that you also may believe
verses.literalPt: E aquele que o viu testificou, e o seu testemunho é verdadeiro; e sabe que é verdade o que diz, para que também vós o creiais.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο γὰρ ταῦτα ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ Ὀστοῦν οὐ συντριβήσεται αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto gar tauta hina hē graphē plērōthē Ostoun ou syntribēsetai autou
verses.literal: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled Not one of His bones will be broken
verses.literalPt: Porque isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse a Escritura, que diz: Nenhum dos seus ossos será quebrado.

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν ἑτέρα γραφὴ λέγει Ὄψονται εἰς ὃν ἐξεκέντησαν
verses.transliteration: kai palin hetera graphē legei Opsontai eis hon exekentēsan
verses.literal: And . . . as another Scripture says They will look on the One they have pierced
verses.literalPt: E outra vez diz a Escritura: Verão aquele que traspassaram.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα ἠρώτησεν τὸν Πιλᾶτον Ἰωσὴφ ὁ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας ὢν μαθητὴς τοῦ Ἰησοῦ κεκρυμμένος δὲ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἦλθεν οὖν καὶ ἦρεν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Meta de tauta ērōtēsen ton Pilaton Iōsēph ho apo Harimathaias ōn mathētēs tou Iēsou kekrymmenos de dia ton phobon tōn Ioudaiōn hina arē to sōma tou Iēsou kai epetrepsen ho Pilatos ēlthen oun kai ēren to sōma autou
verses.literal: Afterward . . . . . . Joseph of Arimathea who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews) asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus - Pilate gave him permission so he came and removed His body
verses.literalPt: Depois disto, José de Arimatéia (o que era discípulo de Jesus, mas oculto, por medo dos judeus) rogou a Pilatos que lhe permitisse tirar o corpo de Jesus. E Pilatos lho permitiu. Então foi e tirou o corpo de Jesus.

verses.original: ἦλθεν δὲ καὶ Νικόδημος ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς τὸ πρῶτον φέρων μίγμα σμύρνης καὶ ἀλόης ὡς λίτρας ἑκατόν
verses.transliteration: ēlthen de kai Nikodēmos ho elthōn pros auton nyktos to prōton pherōn migma smyrnēs kai aloēs hōs litras hekaton
verses.literal: Nicodemus who had previously come . . . . . . to Jesus at night also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes about seventy-five pounds . . .
verses.literalPt: E foi também Nicodemos (aquele que anteriormente se dirigira de noite a Jesus), levando quase cem arráteis de um composto de mirra e aloés.

verses.original: ἔλαβον οὖν τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸ ὀθονίοις μετὰ τῶν ἀρωμάτων καθὼς ἔθος ἐστὶν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ἐνταφιάζειν
verses.transliteration: elabon oun to sōma tou Iēsou kai edēsan auto othoniois meta tōn arōmatōn kathōs ethos estin tois Ioudaiois entaphiazein
verses.literal: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices according to . . . the Jewish burial custom
verses.literalPt: Tomaram, pois, o corpo de Jesus e o envolveram em lençóis com as especiarias, como os judeus costumam fazer, na preparação para o sepulcro.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ὅπου ἐσταυρώθη κῆπος καὶ ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μνημεῖον καινόν ἐν ᾧ οὐδέπω οὐδεὶς ἦν τεθειμένος
verses.transliteration: Ēn de en tō topō hopou estaurōthē kēpos kai en tō kēpō mnēmeion kainon en hō oudepō oudeis ēn tetheimenos
verses.literal: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been . . . laid
verses.literalPt: E havia um horto naquele lugar onde fora crucificado, e no horto um sepulcro novo, em que ainda ninguém havia sido posto.

verses.original: ἐκεῖ οὖν διὰ τὴν Παρασκευὴν τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ μνημεῖον ἔθηκαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: ekei oun dia tēn Paraskeuēn tōn Ioudaiōn hoti engys ēn to mnēmeion ethēkan ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby they placed Jesus there
verses.literalPt: Ali, pois (por causa da preparação dos judeus, e por estar perto aquele sepulcro), puseram a Jesus.
